title: PixelArcade
notes: Physical claim mechanic ... 63 of 64 tokens held by the PixelArcade contract.

works.title: Eight-Bit Study No. 1
works.statement: 1/1 pixel painting from PixelArcade by MintFace. Eight colors sampled from the canonical on-screen palette of Pitfall! (1982), arranged into a fixed grid via simulated annealing. A physical painting is available to commission for NFT holders via the on-chain claim mechanic.

digital.image_source_note: mirror of the on-chain SVG, served from the project repo
